AccountMenu.OrganizationSubmenu.description: A submenu that switches between the person's organizations, with OrganizationSwitcher's rows, for an application whose account menu holds the switch. OrganizationSwitcher stays the control for a switch of its own, such as at the top of a sidebar.

props.name: items
props.description: Organizations the signed-in person belongs to, in display order.

props.name: value
props.description: The active organization's id, or null before one is chosen; its label shows under the row's own.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the id of the organization chosen, unless it is the active one.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Offers creating an organization after the organizations.

props.name: label
props.description: The label of the row that opens the submenu.

props.name: createLabel
props.description: Label of the create action.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label.

AccountMenu.Root.description: The signed-in person's menu: their avatar, or a row with their name, opens a Menu with a header that shows who is signed in, then the application's items, such as account settings, the theme and sign out.

props.name: name
props.description: The signed-in person's name, on the trigger row, in the avatar's tooltip and in the menu's header.

props.name: description
props.description: A second line under the name, such as the e-mail address, on the trigger row and in the header.

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: The person's picture; the default person picture shows without one.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What opens the menu: `row`, the avatar with the name and description, for the foot of a sidebar; `avatar`, the avatar alone, for a header or a sidebar showing icons only; `auto`, a row in an expanded sidebar and the avatar elsewhere.

props.name: side
props.default: 'top' for a row, 'inline-end' for the avatar in a sidebar, else 'bottom'
props.description: The side of the trigger the menu opens on; it flips where the window has no room.

props.name: align
props.description: How the menu lines up with the trigger along that side.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu.

props.name: children
props.description: The menu's items after its header: Menu.Item, Menu.Separator, AccountMenu.ThemeSubmenu, AccountMenu.OrganizationSubmenu and the other Menu parts.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the menu popup. ref, style, data attributes and the other native props go to the popup too; the trigger is the element you pass.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the menu is open, for a controlled menu; leave it out and the menu opens and closes itself.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled menu starts open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new visibility as the menu opens or closes.

AccountMenu.ThemeSubmenu.description: A submenu with the theme choice, System, Light and Dark: a ThemeRadioGroup, which stores the choice through the nearest ThemePreferenceProvider unless value and onValueChange are given.

props.name: label
props.description: The label of the row that opens the submenu.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen preference: system, light or dark.

props.name: onValueChange
props.default: the nearest ThemePreferenceProvider's setPreference, which stores the choice
props.description: Called with the preference chosen, for an application that stores the theme itself.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Close the menu after a choice. Off by default, so people see the theme change with the menu still open.

Alert.description: An inline banner for a page- or section-level message, in its tone. It stays a server component: its dismiss button is a CloseButton, a client leaf named in the provider's language.

props.name: tone
props.description: What the message means: info, success, warning or danger, for an error or a failure. Sets the tint, the border and the icon; info and success alerts are also status messages.

props.name: title
props.description: A short heading for the message, such as "Sync paused", above the message.

props.name: children
props.description: The message: what it means and what people can do.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the tone's icon; false shows none.

props.name: action
props.description: An action below the message, such as a Button or Link.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a dismiss button that calls it; the application removes the alert.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button, also shown as its tooltip.

props.name: announce
props.description: The alert appeared because of something that just happened and should interrupt: warning and danger alerts take the alert role. Info and success alerts are always polite status messages.

AnimatedNumber.description: A number within text that rolls to its new value when it changes: up when it grows and down when it shrinks, so a count updated by other controls is noticed. The text is always the current value.

props.name: value
props.description: The number to show; when it changes, the new value rolls in, up as it grows, down as it shrinks.

props.name: formatValue
props.default: the number format of EnvUIProvider's locale, or else the browser's
props.description: Writes the value as text, such as a currency.

AppShell.Aside.description: The page's region at the end, such as an inspector or details: a complementary landmark beside Main, below the header, that opens and closes (useSidebar('end')) and becomes an end drawer below the breakpoint. A frame has an end Sidebar.Root or an AppShell.Aside, not both.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the complementary landmark and its drawer, such as Details.

props.name: children
props.description: The aside's content, such as an inspector.

props.name: mobile
props.description: Below the frame's breakpoint: drawer, its content in a drawer its trigger opens; none, hidden, for an application that brings its own.

props.name: resizable
props.description: People can resize the expanded sidebar by dragging Sidebar.Handle or with its arrow keys.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: The smallest width in rem.

props.name: maxWidth
props.default: 32 when resizable or with a number width, 20 with the content width
props.description: The largest width in rem.

props.name: resizeLabel
props.description: The handle's name.

props.name: closeOnNavigate
props.description: A press on a link inside dismisses the drawer, a peek or a held rail.

AppShell.Header.description: The frame's header: one row that never wraps, with start content, a title that truncates first, and actions at the end. It is the banner landmark, sticky while the document scrolls, and its fixed height (--env-app-shell-header-height) is the frame's published header size.

props.name: start
props.description: Content at the inline start, such as a SidebarTrigger and the application's mark.

props.name: children
props.description: The title area, such as the page's name: it truncates first, and hides below the breakpoint.

props.name: end
props.description: Actions at the inline end, such as a ThemeToggle and an AccountMenu.

props.name: mobileOnly
props.description: Only below the frame's breakpoint, where the sidebars are drawers: a phone's top bar with the triggers that open them.

AppShell.Main.description: The page's main content: the main landmark, which skip links and a navigation in a drawer move focus to. It has no padding of its own (Page has), and its inline size is a container for container queries. With scroll="main" it is the region that scrolls.

props.name: skipLabel
props.description: The skip link's name.

AppShell.Root.description: The application frame: a header, sidebars at the start and end, the main content and an aside, laid out in a grid that follows the text direction. It keeps the sidebars' state, remembers it with persist, turns the sidebars into drawers below its breakpoint, and publishes the header's size as --env-frame-header-block-size and where sticky content sticks as --env-frame-sticky-top.

props.name: headerSpan
props.description: main: the sidebars run the full height and the header sits beside them. full: the header runs across the window and the sidebars sit below it.

props.name: scroll
props.description: document: the document scrolls under a sticky header. main: the frame fills its container (100dvh, or --env-app-shell-block-size) and AppShell.Main scrolls, with the keyboard scrolling it as it would the document.

props.name: titleBar
props.description: The header is the window's title bar, in an installed web app or a desktop shell that draws its own (the Window Controls Overlay): empty space drags the window, it leaves room for the window controls, and its controls are small, with buttons that set no variant ghost. Implies scroll="main", so Main scrolls below the bar. Meant for headerSpan="full".

props.name: dividers
props.description: Hairlines between the header, the sidebars and the content.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows page progress along the header's bottom edge, such as while the next page loads.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: The progress bar's name.

props.name: landmarks
props.description: false renders the parts without landmark roles, for a preview of a frame inside another page's main content.

props.name: children
props.description: The frame's parts: AppShell.SkipLinks, Sidebar.Root, AppShell.Header, AppShell.Main, AppShell.Aside.

props.name: defaultSidebarOpen
props.description: Whether a sidebar starts docked open where people can dock it; a bare value is the start sidebar's.

props.name: sidebarOpen
props.description: Whether a sidebar is docked open, for state the application controls; per side.

props.name: onSidebarOpenChange
props.type: (open: boolean, details: { side: SidebarSide; reason: SidebarChangeReason }) => void
props.description: Called as a sidebar's docked preference changes: from its trigger, the shortcut, its handle or useSidebar().setOpen.

props.name: defaultSidebarWidth
props.description: The width a resizable sidebar starts at, in rem; per side.

props.name: sidebarWidth
props.description: A resizable sidebar's width in rem, for state the application controls; per side.

props.name: onSidebarWidthChange
props.type: (width: number, details: { side: SidebarSide; committed: boolean }) => void
props.description: Called with the new width in rem while a sidebar is resized (committed false) and once more as the drag ends or a key moves it (committed true).

props.name: persist
props.description: Remember the docked preference and the chosen width of each sidebar under this key: a string keeps them in localStorage, read after hydration; { key, storage: 'cookie' } keeps them in a cookie the server reads with readAppShellCookie. Peeking and the drawers are never kept.

props.name: initialState
props.description: The state the server read with readAppShellCookie, so hydration meets the server's markup. Without it the frame reads its storage after hydration: a server-rendered page first shows the defaults, and a page rendered only in the browser reads it before its first paint.

props.name: breakpoint
props.description: Below this viewport width the sidebars become drawers opened from their triggers: sm, md, lg or xl (40, 48, 64 or 80 rem). md also covers short landscape windows, such as a phone's.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: A keyboard shortcut that toggles a sidebar, or its drawer below the breakpoint, such as mod+b (⌘B on Apple platforms, Ctrl+B elsewhere); a bare value is the start sidebar's. It is ignored in text fields and editors, where Mod+B is often Bold. false listens for nothing.

AppShell.SkipLinks.description: Links before everything else that move keyboard focus past the frame: Skip to content (Main), then Skip to each sidebar that is in reach now, then `links`. Hidden until focused; the first tab stop of the page. Outside AppShell.Root it renders only `links`.

props.name: links
props.description: Extra targets after the generated ones, such as a search field.

Avatar.description: A round picture of a person or organization, with the default person picture or initials as fallback.

props.name: name
props.description: Person or organization name: the accessible name of a named avatar, and the initials fallback.

props.name: src
props.description: Picture URL. The fallback shows while it loads and when it is missing or fails.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Shown without a picture: the default person picture, or initials (for example, for an organization).

props.name: hue
props.description: The fill behind the initials or the person picture. Without it, the name chooses one, the same for the same name everywhere; set it for an organization with a color of its own.

props.name: size
props.description: sm 1.5 rem, md 2 rem, lg 3 rem or xl 5.5 rem, such as for a profile page.

props.name: named
props.description: Names the avatar as an image by `name`. Without it, the avatar is hidden from assistive technology, for when text beside it already names the person.

AvatarButton.description: A person's avatar as a button, typically the account menu trigger in a topbar. A halo shows hover, press and an open menu, and the tooltip names the account.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name: shown in the tooltip, and the accessible name unless aria-label is set.

props.name: description
props.description: A second tooltip line, such as the e-mail address of the signed-in account.

props.name: src
props.description: Picture URL; the default person picture shows without one.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Shown without a picture: the default person picture (default), or the initials of `name`.

props.name: size
props.description: The picture: sm 1.5 rem, md 2 rem or lg 3 rem, inside a slightly larger hit area, which grows to the touch height under a coarse pointer.

AvatarGroup.description: Overlapping avatars for a set of people, such as the members of a project, with a chip that counts the rest and lists them in its tooltip. A ring in the color of the surface below separates the avatars.

props.name: people
props.description: The people, in order. Pass a preview with total when there are many more.

props.name: max
props.description: The most avatars to show; the overflow chip after them counts the rest. All by default.

props.name: size
props.description: As Avatar: sm 1.5 rem, md 2 rem, lg 3 rem or xl 5.5 rem.

props.name: total
props.description: How many people there are in all, when people is only a preview of them.

props.name: onPersonClick
props.description: Makes every avatar a button with a name tooltip; receives the person pressed.

props.name: formatMore
props.description: Text for people beyond the list, in the overflow tooltip and the group's name. It overrides EnvUIProvider's `messages.avatarGroup.more` for this group.

props.name: formatLabel
props.description: The group's name from the number of people and their names, which end with formatMore's text for people counted in total but not listed, such as "3 people: Alex Morgan, Sam Lee, 1 more". It overrides EnvUIProvider's `messages.avatarGroup.label` for this group; aria-label replaces it.

Badge.description: A small pill label for a state, such as In progress, Blocked or Archived, or for neutral metadata, such as a plan or a count of seats.

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning of the state; done is the purple of completed work. Neutral by default.

props.name: variant
props.description: soft tints the background, solid fills it with the tone, outline draws a border.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label, such as a check mark; hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: children
props.description: The label: a state, a name or a category in a word or two. It stays on one line and ends with an ellipsis where the badge is wider than its container.

Box.description: A plain block for what needs no row or column of its own: an inset (`padding`), a size container (`container`) or a named node. It sizes to its content and never paints.

props.name: render
props.description: The element to render, for its meaning, such as render={<section />} or render={<ul />}, or another component to lay out without a wrapper, such as a Surface: the primitive's attributes merge into its props. It must forward native props and refs. A div by default.

props.name: ref
props.description: The rendered element, a div by default. Its type is the element type parameter, which a ref passed in sets: a ref to the element that render makes, such as useRef<HTMLElement>(null) with render={<section />}, type-checks.

props.name: name
props.description: A name for this node, such as "filters" or "summary", which dev mode and the docs show; it renders as `data-env-name`. A component's part class names its node instead.

props.name: container
props.description: Makes the element a size container of this name, for container queries on its inline size, such as container="filters" for `@container filters (width >= 37.5rem)`. A container is as wide as its context gives it, never as its content. container="env-window" makes the element a window of its own on purpose, such as a preview frame, whose content lays out at its window class; other `env-*` names are envUI's own.

props.name: padding
props.description: The inset on every side, a step of the spacing scale. None by default.

Breadcrumbs.description: The path from the top level to the current page; earlier levels are links.

props.name: items
props.description: From the top level to the current page, which is last.

props.name: wrap
props.description: The trail wraps onto more lines when it runs out of room; true by default. False keeps it on one line, for a bar or header: the current page is cut short first, and earlier levels keep their width.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark; name each trail where a page has several.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the `nav` element.

Button.description: Starts an action, or goes to a destination with href, in one of five variants and three tones, with optional icons; icon-only with iconOnly. It renders a native button or link.

props.name: variant
props.description: The emphasis: primary for the main action of a view, secondary and outline for the rest, ghost for an application's chrome, such as a toolbar, and text for a link-like action. Without it, the button takes the variant its container gives where that variant takes its tone, such as ghost in a toolbar, and else primary.

props.name: tone
props.description: The meaning: neutral for most actions; accent, on a primary button only, for a rare consequential action, with 0.5 rem corners; danger for an action that deletes or ends something. Secondary buttons are always neutral.

props.name: underline
props.description: Show an underline for the text variant; defaults to false.

props.name: size
props.description: The height, as on every control: sm, md or lg in the current scale, such as sm for an action in a table cell or lg for the main call to action of a page. Without it, the button takes the control height of its container, md unless the container sets another. A button beside a field takes the field's size.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fill the width of the container, such as the actions of a narrow form stacked in a column. An icon-only button keeps its square size.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label, such as an Add icon.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: A decorative icon after the label, such as a ChevronRight for a next step.

props.name: pending
props.description: Work started by this button is running: a spinner replaces the content without changing the button's size, and the button reports busy and ignores activation until pending ends.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled button cannot be pressed; a disabled link has no destination, cannot be focused or followed, and reports aria-disabled.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The action's name, such as Delete draft, for an icon-only button.

props.name: href
props.description: The destination: the element is a native link, through the LinkProvider's link component.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Show only icon, in a square button that keeps its size; name it with aria-label.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon of an icon-only button.

ButtonGroup.description: Connected buttons keep their own outer corners and share the row inner radius.

props.name: orientation
props.description: A row of buttons, or a column in which every button is as wide as the group.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fill the container's width, such as a sidebar's: in a row, labelled buttons share the room the icon-only ones leave, which keep their square size, and a row of icon-only buttons shares it evenly; in a column, every button is as wide as the group.

Calendar.description: A month of days to choose one from, following the WAI-ARIA date picker grid: the arrow keys move by day and week, Page Up and Page Down by month (with Shift, by year), Home and End to the week's ends, and Enter or Space chooses the day. Named with aria-label or aria-labelledby, it is a group around the month's grid.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen day as YYYY-MM-DD, or null for none.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The day an uncontrolled calendar starts with; none by default, which shows today's month.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the chosen day as YYYY-MM-DD.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest day that can be chosen, as YYYY-MM-DD; earlier days are unavailable.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest day that can be chosen, as YYYY-MM-DD; later days are unavailable.

props.name: weekStart
props.description: The first day of each week, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday: by default the locale's, or Monday where the browser cannot tell.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the month and weekday names and the day numbers: EnvUIProvider's, else the browser's. The days are always Gregorian, also in a locale with a calendar of its own.

props.name: previousMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the previous month button.

props.name: nextMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next month button.

CalendarHeatmap.description: A calendar of daily values with weeks as columns and weekdays as rows, colored in steps of a tone. Each day names its date and value, shows them in a tooltip on hover and focus, and the grid is one tab stop that the arrow keys move through.

props.name: data
props.description: Values by day; days without an entry count as 0.

props.name: startDate
props.description: The first day shown, as YYYY-MM-DD; the earliest day in data by default.

props.name: endDate
props.description: The last day shown, as YYYY-MM-DD; the latest day in data by default.

props.name: levels
props.description: Color steps including the empty step, 2 to 10; 5 by default.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: The value that takes the strongest color; the largest value shown by default.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: The lowest value of each color step above the empty one, in ascending order, such as quantiles of the data to color by rank. Up to nine; they replace levels and maxValue. A day below the first threshold shows as empty, and a first threshold of 0 or less colors days of 0 too.

props.name: weekStart
props.description: The first day of each week column: 0 for Sunday (default) or 1 for Monday.

props.name: tone
props.description: The tone the colors are mixed from: accent by default.

props.name: formatValue
props.default: the number format of EnvUIProvider's locale, or else the browser's
props.description: Text for a value.

props.name: formatDate
props.default: the weekday, day, month and year in the locale, such as Tue 14 Oct 2025
props.description: Text for a day's date, in its accessible name and the default tooltip.

props.name: formatTooltip
props.description: Tooltip content for a day; the date and value by default.

props.name: monthLabels
props.default: the locale's short month names, from Intl
props.description: Twelve month names above the weeks, from January.

props.name: weekdayLabels
props.default: the locale's short weekday names, from Intl
props.description: Seven weekday names beside the rows, from Sunday.

props.name: lessLabel
props.description: Legend text before the lightest color. It overrides EnvUIProvider's `messages.calendarHeatmap.less`.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Legend text after the strongest color. It overrides EnvUIProvider's `messages.calendarHeatmap.more`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the grid of days, such as "Deployments in the last year"; this or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of visible text that names the grid of days, such as a heading; this or aria-label.

Card.description: A rounded surface that groups content about one subject: a content card with an optional title row and actions, a feature card with an icon and an action, or one link or button.

props.name: background
props.description: The fill: muted, the standalone card fill; default, a quieter fill that groups content, such as a section of a settings page; or page, the page's own color, for a card inside a pane.

props.name: padding
props.default: 1.25 rem in narrow windows, growing to 1.5 rem from 50 rem wide
props.description: The inset on every side, as a step of the spacing scale, such as 6 for 2 rem; 0 removes it. Without it, the inset follows the window's width.

props.name: title
props.description: The card's title at the top: an `h3` in the title type, or in the feature layout an `h2` in the headline type. headingLevel sets another level.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The title's heading level, for the page's outline; the type stays as the layout sets it.

props.name: meta
props.description: A short fact at the end of the title row, such as when the card was updated.

props.name: description
props.description: A sentence under the title, in muted text.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative icon at the start of the feature layout, 1.5 rem in the muted color; hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: actions
props.description: The card's controls, such as Buttons: in a strip along the bottom of the card, or in the feature layout at its end, moving below the text and filling the card's width in a card narrower than 38 rem.

props.name: layout
props.description: stack, content spaced 1 rem apart, with the actions in a strip along the bottom; or feature, an icon at the start, the title and description, and the actions at the end.

props.name: render
props.description: The element for the card's meaning, such as render={<article />} or render={<section />}. A div by default.

props.name: href
props.description: The destination: the whole card is one native link, through the LinkProvider.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs when the card is pressed: the whole card is one native button.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled link card has no destination, cannot be focused and reports aria-disabled; a disabled button card cannot be pressed.

Checkbox.description: A native checkbox inside its label, checked, unchecked or mixed.

props.name: ref
props.description: The native checkbox, so that a form library can register it and focus it; the other native props, such as name and required, reach it too.

props.name: className
props.description: The checkbox's class, on its root element, the label around the box and the text.

props.name: style
props.description: Styles of the root element.

props.name: label
props.description: The text beside the box, which names the checkbox; pressing it toggles the checkbox.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the box is checked, unchecked or "mixed", for a parent whose children are partly chosen. With `onCheckedChange` it controls the checkbox.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: How an uncontrolled checkbox starts, and what a form reset restores; unchecked by default.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when people press the checkbox; a mixed checkbox reports true.

CloseButton.description: The button that closes, dismisses or removes what it sits in, such as a dialog, a notification, a tab or a chip: an icon-only button with a cross, named Close in the provider's language. Under a coarse pointer, its hit area reaches the touch size even where it draws smaller.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The button's name, such as Close notification or Remove Alex Morgan where more than one thing closes nearby.

props.name: variant
props.description: ghost, the quiet icon on chrome and inside surfaces, or secondary, on the neutral fill, where the button should read as a control of its own, such as over an image.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon; a Close cross by default.

props.name: size
props.description: As Button's: the height, and the width, of the square button.

props.name: pending
props.description: As Button's: a spinner replaces the icon while the work runs.

Code.description: Inline source in the code theme of the app theme; use CodeBlock for multiline source.

CodeBlock.description: Source display in the code theme of the app theme, with that code theme's own colors; copy always uses the original string. Its words come from EnvUIProvider's messages.codeBlock.

props.name: children
props.description: The source, as one string; it is shown, highlighted and copied as it is.

props.name: language
props.description: The language to highlight: js, jsx, ts, tsx, java, json, html, xml, css, sql, sh, bash, yaml, md or ini, or their full names. Other values, and none, leave the source plain text.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the block in its heading and for assistive technology, such as a file name.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Shows a copy button in the heading that copies the source; false by default.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling them; false by default.

CodeDiff.description: The changes between two versions of a file, rendered by Diffs (diffs.com) in its own Pierre theme for the app theme, as code blocks are; the whole file when nothing changed.

props.name: before
props.description: The source before the change.

props.name: after
props.description: The source after the change.

props.name: filename
props.description: Names the file in the header and chooses its language, such as form.json.

props.name: language
props.description: Overrides the language the file name implies, such as json.

props.name: header
props.description: Shows the file header with its name and change counts; true by default.

props.name: expandUnchanged
props.description: Shows the unchanged lines between changes instead of folding them; false by default.

props.name: layout
props.description: auto (default) sets old and new side by side from 56 rem of width; unified keeps one column.

ColorPicker.description: A labelled color area, hue slider and native HEX field; the application owns the result. The area and the hue are sliders for the keyboard and assistive technology, named after the label in the EnvUIProvider's language, such as Accent color saturation and brightness and Accent color hue.

props.name: ref
props.description: The HEX field, so that a form library can register it and focus it.

props.name: className
props.description: The picker's class, on its root element.

props.name: style
props.description: Styles of the picker's root element.

props.name: label
props.description: The color's name above the picker; it names the group and, with "HEX", the field.

props.name: value
props.description: An opaque six-digit HEX color, with an optional # prefix.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The color an uncontrolled picker starts at, and that a form reset restores; #000000 by default.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives valid colors normalized to lowercase #rrggbb.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Short, non-interactive text before the value, such as the start of an address. It is not part of the value; it shows once the field has focus or a value and is read after the label.

props.name: size
props.description: The height, as on every control: sm, md or lg in the current scale. Without it, the field takes the control height of its container, md unless the container sets another, as a table cell does. A button beside a field takes the field's size. Floating and underline fields have their own height.

props.name: description
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: variant
props.description: The field's look: outline, with a thin border, at the control height; floating, an outlined field 3.5 rem tall whose label rests inside and floats into the outline, for long forms on a page; underline, as tall, with no border or fill and an underline on hover and focus; or ghost, only its text and start icon at rest, with a soft fill under the pointer and while focused and a placeholder that clears on focus, for a search at the top of a sidebar or a list.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: A decorative icon at the start of the field, such as Search or Mail.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the description.

props.name: endAction
props.description: A control at the end of the field, such as an IconButton that reveals or copies the value; name it with aria-label. A button that sets no variant takes ghost here.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label in the field, where it rests while the field is empty and floats into the outline while the field has focus or a value. Set false for a field whose purpose is clear without it, such as a search in a toolbar: the label still names the field for assistive technology, and a placeholder gives the visible guidance.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Short, non-interactive text after the value, such as a unit. It is not part of the value; it shows once the field has focus or a value and is read after the label.

ColorSwatch.description: A round sample of a color with a hairline ring, so light and dark colors stay visible on every surface. It is decorative: name the color in the text beside it. As a Button's icon it takes the icon's size, such as on a button that opens a ColorPicker.

props.name: color
props.description: The color it shows, such as #6750a4.

Column.description: Lays its direct children out one under another, `gap` apart, such as a form's fields. A flex column that sizes to its content and never paints.

props.name: gap
props.description: The space between the direct children, a step of the spacing scale. None by default.

props.name: align
props.description: How the children line up across the line: stretch, the default, makes each as wide as a column or as tall as a row, except controls such as buttons, which keep their own size; start, center and end keep every child at its own size.

props.name: justify
props.description: Where the children sit along the line when there is room to spare: at the start, in the center, at the end, such as a form's actions, or between, spread out to the edges.

props.name: render
props.description: The element to render, for its meaning, such as render={<section />} or render={<ul />}, or another component to lay out without a wrapper, such as a Surface: the primitive's attributes merge into its props. It must forward native props and refs. A div by default.

props.name: ref
props.description: The rendered element, a div by default. Its type is the element type parameter, which a ref passed in sets: a ref to the element that render makes, such as useRef<HTMLElement>(null) with render={<section />}, type-checks.

props.name: name
props.description: A name for this node, such as "filters" or "summary", which dev mode and the docs show; it renders as `data-env-name`. A component's part class names its node instead.

props.name: container
props.description: Makes the element a size container of this name, for container queries on its inline size, such as container="filters" for `@container filters (width >= 37.5rem)`. A container is as wide as its context gives it, never as its content. container="env-window" makes the element a window of its own on purpose, such as a preview frame, whose content lays out at its window class; other `env-*` names are envUI's own.

props.name: padding
props.description: The inset on every side, a step of the spacing scale. None by default.

Combobox.description: A text field that filters a list of options as people type, for choosing one option or several. Chosen options show as removable chips; keyboard, focus and announcements follow the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern.

props.name: ref
props.description: The text input, so that a form library can register it and focus it.

props.name: className
props.description: The field's class, on its root element, beside env-field and env-combobox.

props.name: style
props.description: Styles of the field's root element.

props.name: items
props.description: The options, or groups of options under headings, in display order.

props.name: filter
props.description: Which options match the typed text: by default those whose label or description contains it, ignoring case and accents. null shows the items as given, for searching on the server.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Receives the typed text, and an empty string once it is cleared, such as to search a server.

props.name: loading
props.description: The options are loading: the popup shows loadingLabel instead of emptyLabel.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Shown in the popup while loading.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown in the popup when no option matches.

props.name: variant
props.description: The field's look, as TextField's: outline, at the control height, or floating, 3.5 rem tall with room for its label, for long forms on a page.

props.name: size
props.description: The field's height, as on every control: sm, md or lg in the current scale. Without it, the field takes the control height of its container, md unless the container sets another. The popup's rows take the row height of the scale.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label inside the field, where it floats into the outline while the field has focus or a value. Set false for a field whose purpose is clear without it; a placeholder then gives the visible guidance.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A clear button removes the value while there is one; Esc on the closed field clears it too.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button.

props.name: removeLabel
props.default: Remove followed by the label, or EnvUIProvider's messages.combobox.remove
props.description: Accessible name of a chip's remove button, from the chip's label.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the list is open; with `onOpenChange` it controls the popup.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled list starts open; closed by default.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called as the popup opens and closes, such as to load the options as it opens.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the default filter's matching: EnvUIProvider's, else the browser's.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible name, such as Project name; it also names the control for assistive technology.

props.name: description
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the description.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Several options can be chosen; they show as chips in the field.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen option's value, or null for none.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value an uncontrolled field starts with, and that a form reset restores; none by default.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: ((value: string | null, item: Item | null) => void) | ((value: string[], items: Item[]) => void)
props.description: Receives the chosen value and its option, or null twice once the field is cleared.

CommandPalette.description: A quick-open dialog near the top of the window: a search field over a list of options the application filters and ranks, built on Base UI's Autocomplete inside a dialog. The arrow keys move the highlight while typing continues, and the number of results is announced as it changes. className, style, ref and data attributes go to the dialog's surface.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the palette is open; the application opens it, such as from a shortcut.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with false when Esc, a press on the backdrop or a choice closes the palette.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the dialog, the search field and the list.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The text in the search field.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Receives the text as people type.

props.name: items
props.description: Filtered and ranked by the application, in display order.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Enter or a press on an option; Ctrl or Cmd sets modifier.

props.name: closeOnAction
props.description: Close after an option is chosen.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the empty search field, such as "Search documents by name or folder".

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown in place of the list when there are no items, and announced.

props.name: hints
props.description: Key hints below the list, such as { keys: ['Enter'], label: 'Open' }.

props.name: footer
props.description: Other content below the list, after the hints.

Composer.description: The message field of a conversation: a multiline field on a raised surface that grows with its text up to maxRows, with a send button at the end that becomes a stop button while running. Enter submits, Shift+Enter starts a new line and an input method's composition never submits. Without onSubmit, Enter and the send button submit the field's form.

props.name: value
props.description: The message text of a controlled composer.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting text of an uncontrolled composer; it clears after each submit through onSubmit and when its form resets.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the text as it changes, and an empty string when an uncontrolled composer clears.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Enter or the send button submits the text as typed, and an uncontrolled composer clears. Blank text never submits, and neither does a disabled, running or pending composer. Without onSubmit, they submit the field's form instead and the text stays until the form resets. Without onSubmit or a form there is nothing to send: the button is unavailable and Enter starts a new line.

props.name: pending
props.description: A send is in progress, such as a request the application makes: sending is unavailable while the field stays editable and keeps focus. The pending action of an enclosing form counts too; set pending for a form the field joins through its form attribute, or for a request of the application's own.

props.name: running
props.description: A reply is on its way: the send button becomes a stop button and Enter does not submit.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called by the stop button while running; it stays available when the field is disabled.

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the send button.

props.name: stopLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the stop button.

props.name: minRows
props.description: Lines the field shows while empty; 1 by default.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Lines the field grows to before it scrolls; 8 by default.

props.name: start
props.description: Content at the start of the action row, such as an attach button or the name of a model.

props.name: footer
props.description: Supporting text below the composer, such as a note on attachments; it describes the field.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the field, which has no visible label, such as "Message"; this or aria-labelledby.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of visible text that names the field; this or aria-label.

ConfirmButton.description: A button for an action that takes effect at once and cannot be undone. The first press arms it and names the consequence in place; a second press runs it. It disarms after a few seconds, when focus leaves and on Escape.

props.name: size
props.description: The height, as on every control: sm, md or lg in the current scale, such as sm for an action in a table cell or lg for the main call to action of a page. Without it, the button takes the control height of its container, md unless the container sets another. A button beside a field takes the field's size.

props.name: underline
props.description: Show an underline for the text variant; defaults to false.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fill the width of the container, such as the actions of a narrow form stacked in a column. An icon-only button keeps its square size.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label, such as an Add icon.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: A decorative icon after the label, such as a ChevronRight for a next step.

props.name: pending
props.description: Work started by this button is running: a spinner replaces the content without changing the button's size, and the button reports busy and ignores activation until pending ends.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The label while armed, naming what a second press does, such as “Remove Morgan?”.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Runs on the second press, while the button is armed.

props.name: armedDuration
props.description: How long the button stays armed without a second press, in milliseconds.

props.name: icon
props.description: A round icon-only button at rest, named by aria-label. Armed, it shows the icon with the confirm label, so the consequence is still named.

props.name: tone
props.description: The resting meaning, as Button's: neutral, or danger on a primary, outline, ghost or text button.

ConfirmDialog.description: Asks people to confirm an action whose consequence needs a sentence, such as deleting a project: an alert dialog with a question, a description, Cancel and a confirm button that names the consequence. It waits for onConfirm's promise, pending, and stays open when it fails. className, style, ref and data attributes go to the dialog's surface.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open, for a dialog the application controls with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether a dialog the application doesn't control is open on the first render.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the requested state, and why, when the dialog opens or closes: from the trigger, Escape, Cancel, or after onConfirm finishes. Not called for a dismissal that a running onConfirm blocks.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the dialog, such as a Button. Omit it for a dialog the application opens with open, such as from a menu item.

props.name: title
props.description: The question, which names the dialog, such as “Delete Northwind launch?”.

props.name: description
props.description: What confirming does and whether it can be undone; it describes the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: More content between the heading and the actions, such as what else the action affects, or the one field a confirmation holds, such as a typed name. The dialog is a form: Enter in a field confirms as the confirm button does, through onConfirm. Hold no form here; use Dialog for one.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The confirm button's label: a verb that names the consequence, such as Delete project.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The cancel button's label.

props.name: tone
props.description: danger for an action that deletes or ends something: the confirm button is a danger one and focus starts on Cancel, so a hurried Enter doesn't confirm. neutral starts focus on the confirm button.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Runs the action when the confirm button is pressed, or Enter is pressed in a field in the dialog. The dialog closes when it returns, or, when it returns a promise, once the promise resolves; while it runs, the confirm button is pending and nothing dismisses the dialog. It runs once per opening: further presses, such as the second click of a double-click, are ignored until it fails or the dialog opens again. A rejected promise or a thrown error keeps it open and is passed to reportError, so show what went wrong with error.

props.name: error
props.description: What went wrong, shown as a danger Alert above the actions and announced.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: The element to focus when the dialog closes, such as the menu button whose item opened it. By default focus returns to the trigger, or to the element that had focus when it opened.

ContextMenu.description: Actions for an area, opened by right click, long press, the ContextMenu key or Shift+F10.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu, such as Document actions.

props.name: content
props.description: Menu content: Menu.Item, Menu.Group, Menu.Separator and the other menu parts. A function receives the element the menu was opened on: the deepest element under the pointer, or the focused element (its active descendant, when it has one) for the keyboard. Where it returns null, undefined, false or '', the menu doesn't open on that element and the browser keeps its own.

props.name: children
props.description: One element that becomes the region; it must accept native props and a ref.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The region keeps the browser's own context menu.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility, for example to open the menu from another control.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new visibility as the menu opens or closes.

props.name: anchorPoint
props.description: Viewport point to open at while controlled; otherwise the menu opens at the pointer.

props.name: className
props.description: Class of the menu popup.

props.name: ref
props.description: The menu popup's ref; the region is the element you pass as children.

props.name: style
props.description: The menu popup's inline style.

CopyButton.description: Copies text to the clipboard. Icon-only by default, with its name in a tooltip, or a labelled button with children. After a press the icon becomes a check, and Copied shows in the tooltip and is announced for two seconds, or Couldn’t copy when the clipboard refuses.

props.name: value
props.description: The text to copy, or a function that returns it, also as a promise, when pressed.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Runs once the text is on the clipboard, with that text.

props.name: write
props.description: Writes the text instead of the browser's Clipboard API, such as through a desktop app's clipboard bridge. A rejected promise shows and announces failedLabel.

props.name: size
props.description: As Button's: sm, md or lg; without it, the control height of the container.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon at rest, ContentCopy by default; a check replaces it once the text is copied.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Shown in the tooltip and announced after copying; Copied by default.

props.name: failedLabel
props.description: Shown in the tooltip and announced when nothing could be copied; Couldn’t copy by default.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: The button's name, also in an icon-only button's tooltip, where it has none of its own: no aria-label or aria-labelledby, and a label without words, such as an empty string; Copy by default.

props.name: variant
props.description: The emphasis, as Button's. Without it, the button takes the variant its container gives, such as ghost in a toolbar, and else secondary.

props.name: tone
props.description: The meaning, as Button's: accent on a primary button only, and danger on a primary, outline, ghost or text one. A secondary button is always neutral.

props.name: children
props.description: Without children, or with children that render nothing, the button is icon-only, named by aria-label, such as Copy link; a blank one leaves it named by copyLabel.

CounterBadge.description: A compact rounded count, for example beside a navigation label or a menu item.

props.name: value
props.description: The count, such as 12, or short text such as 99+; shown in tabular figures.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Full meaning for assistive technology, such as "12 unread"; the number alone otherwise.

props.name: tone
props.description: neutral (default) is a quiet fill; accent draws attention.

DatePicker.description: A field for a date, or a date and time, that shows the value in the reader's locale and opens a calendar to choose it, with keyboard access following the WAI-ARIA date picker.

props.name: ref
props.description: The field's button, which shows the value and opens the calendar.

props.name: className
props.description: The field's class, on its root element, beside env-field and env-date-picker.

props.name: style
props.description: Styles of the field's root element.

props.name: value
props.description: The value: a day as YYYY-MM-DD, or with the minute granularity a local date and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm. null, or an empty string, for none.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value an uncontrolled field starts with, and that a form reset restores; none by default.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives the new value, or null once the field is cleared.

props.name: granularity
props.description: What the value holds: day, a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or minute, a date and a time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, chosen in a list of times beside the calendar.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest value, as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm; earlier days are unavailable.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest value, as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm; later days are unavailable.

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: The time a newly chosen day starts with, as HH:mm; 00:00 by default.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: With the minute granularity, the minutes between the times the list offers, from 1 to 60. A value between them still shows in the list, in its place.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the shown value and the calendar's names and numbers: EnvUIProvider's, else the browser's. Dates are Gregorian, also in a locale with a calendar of its own.

props.name: weekStart
props.description: The calendar's first day of the week, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday; see Calendar.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: How the field shows the value: Intl.DateTimeFormat options, by default the medium date style and, with the minute granularity, the short time style, in the Gregorian calendar unless they name another.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the value is submitted under with a form, as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

props.name: required
props.description: A value is needed: an empty field keeps its form from submitting and takes focus.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The value can be read and focused but not changed.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field is empty and its label floats or is hidden.

props.name: variant
props.description: The field's look, as TextField's: outline, at the control height, or floating, 3.5 rem tall with room for its label, for long forms on a page.

props.name: size
props.description: The field's height, as on every control: sm, md or lg in the current scale. Without it, the field takes the control height of its container, md unless the container sets another.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label inside the field, where it floats into the outline while the field has a value, focus or its calendar open. Set false for a field whose purpose is clear without it.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A clear button in the field and in the calendar removes the value.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the calendar is open; with `onOpenChange` it controls it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled calendar starts open; closed by default.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the calendar opens or closes.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the field's clear button and text of the calendar's.

props.name: todayLabel
props.description: The calendar's shortcut to today.

props.name: nowLabel
props.description: With the minute granularity, the calendar's shortcut to the current date and time.

props.name: timeLabel
props.description: With the minute granularity, the heading and accessible name of the list of times.

props.name: previousMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the calendar's previous month button.

props.name: nextMonthLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the calendar's next month button.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible name, such as Project name; it also names the control for assistive technology.

props.name: description
props.description: Lasting guidance under the field, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the field that says how to correct the value. While it is set, the control is invalid (aria-invalid) and the message joins its description, after the description.

DescriptionList.Item.description: One term and its value: a `div` around a `dt` and a `dd`.

props.name: label
props.description: The term, such as Owner or Created.

props.name: children
props.description: The value: text, a link, a Badge, or a control in a list with `controls`.

DescriptionList.Root.description: A list of labelled values, the facts about one thing, such as a project's owner, status and dates: a `dl` whose items are its terms with their values.

props.name: layout
props.description: Where each label sits: inline, beside its value, in a column as wide as the longest label; stacked, above its value; auto, inline, stacked below 24 rem of the list's own width.

props.name: size
props.description: The text size: sm, the smaller body text, for facts beside other content, such as in a sidebar or a card; md, body text, for a page of details.

props.name: controls
props.description: The values hold controls, such as a Select or a Switch: each row is at least as tall as a small control, and its label sits on the control's first line.

Dialog.description: A focused task over the page: a centered modal, or a modal near the top of the window. It has a title, an optional description, content and actions that start with a built-in close button. Base UI's dialog owns focus, Escape and outside presses. className, style, ref and data attributes go to the dialog's surface.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open, for a dialog the application controls with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether a dialog the application doesn't control is open on the first render.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the requested state, and why, when the dialog asks to open or close: from the trigger, Escape, an outside press, the close button or a DialogClose. Not called for a dismissal that pending blocks.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the dialog, such as a Button. It reports the dialog it opens, and focus returns to it on close. Omit it for a dialog the application opens with open.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog's heading and accessible name, such as “Delete project?”.

props.name: description
props.description: Muted text under the title that describes the dialog to assistive technology too, such as what its action changes.

props.name: children
props.description: The content between the heading and the actions, such as text, fields or a list.

props.name: actions
props.description: The dialog's own actions, after the built-in close button, with the primary action last. They close the dialog only where they are DialogClose or set open to false.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The label of the built-in close button that starts the actions, such as Cancel.

props.name: placement
props.description: center for a modal in the middle of the window; top for a modal near the top of the window for search-like tasks, so results grow downward without moving the field. For a panel at an edge of the window, use Drawer.

props.name: width
props.description: md, 28 rem wide, or lg, 44 rem, for content-heavy dialogs such as tables, comparisons and longer forms. Both narrow to fit the window.

props.name: modal
props.description: true traps focus in the dialog over a backdrop, hides the page from assistive technology, blocks presses on it and locks its scroll. false leaves the page usable beside the dialog; it then closes when focus or a press goes outside it, unless disablePointerDismissal.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description: Keep the dialog open on presses outside it, and a non-modal dialog also when focus moves outside. Escape and the close buttons still close it.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: The element to focus when the dialog opens, as a ref or a function of how it was opened. By default focus moves to the first focusable element inside, such as the first field, or to the dialog itself when opened by touch.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: The element to focus when the dialog closes, such as the row that opened it. By default focus returns to the trigger, or to the element that had focus when the dialog opened.

props.name: pending
props.description: Work started from the dialog is in progress. Escape, outside presses and the close buttons cannot dismiss it until pending returns to false. The built-in close button is disabled and the dialog reports busy; a DialogClose stays enabled and runs its onClick, so disable it too. Set pending on the action that started the work as well.

DialogClose.description: A button inside a Dialog or a Drawer that closes it after its own onClick, for an action other than the built-in close button, such as Don't save or Done. It takes Button's props and is secondary by default.

props.name: variant
props.description: The emphasis, as Button's; secondary by default, as an action beside the dialog's main one.

props.name: tone
props.description: The meaning: neutral for most actions; accent, on a primary button only, for a rare consequential action, with 0.5 rem corners; danger for an action that deletes or ends something. Secondary buttons are always neutral.

props.name: underline
props.description: Show an underline for the text variant; defaults to false.

props.name: size
props.description: The height, as on every control: sm, md or lg in the current scale, such as sm for an action in a table cell or lg for the main call to action of a page. Without it, the button takes the control height of its container, md unless the container sets another. A button beside a field takes the field's size.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fill the width of the container, such as the actions of a narrow form stacked in a column. An icon-only button keeps its square size.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: A decorative icon before the label, such as an Add icon.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: A decorative icon after the label, such as a ChevronRight for a next step.

props.name: pending
props.description: Work started by this button is running: a spinner replaces the content without changing the button's size, and the button reports busy and ignores activation until pending ends.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The action's name, such as Delete draft, for an icon-only button.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Show only icon, in a square button that keeps its size; name it with aria-label.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon of an icon-only button.

DiffStat.description: The size of a change as one compact pill, such as +12 −3: additions in the success tone and deletions in the danger tone, on a counter badge's quiet fill.

props.name: additions
props.description: Lines or items added, shown as +12 in the success tone, in the locale's digits.

props.name: deletions
props.description: Lines or items removed, shown as −3 in the danger tone, in the locale's digits.

props.name: formatLabel
props.description: Full meaning for assistive technology. It overrides EnvUIProvider's `messages.diffStat.label`.

Disclosure.description: A summary that shows and hides the details below it, on the native details element.

props.name: title
props.description: The summary: one line that says what the details hold and opens or closes them.

props.name: children
props.description: The details, shown below the summary while the disclosure is open.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the details show, for a controlled disclosure: update it from onOpenChange. Use defaultOpen instead to leave it to the disclosure.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the details show at first, for a disclosure that keeps its own state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Receives whether the details show, each time the disclosure opens or closes.

DocumentTabs.description: Editor-style closable tabs for open documents; the application renders the active document.

props.name: items
props.description: The open documents, in tab order.

props.name: value
props.description: The active tab, or null.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a tab is clicked or reached with the arrow keys, Home or End.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called from a tab's close button, a middle click, Delete or Backspace on the focused tab, and Close in the tab's context menu.

props.name: onPin
props.description: Called when a tab is double-clicked, typically to keep a preview tab open.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: Called with every tab's id in the new order when a tab is dragged to another place with a mouse or pen, or moved with Move left or Move right in its context menu, which also reach the keyboard and touch. Without it, the tabs keep their order.

props.name: end
props.description: Content after the tabs, outside the strip that scrolls and on its hairline, such as a button that closes every tab or opens a new one.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the tab strip.

props.name: panelId
props.description: Id of the panel the application renders for the active tab.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The name of the context menu's item that closes a tab, and the tooltip of its close button.

props.name: onCloseAll
props.description: Called from Close all tabs in the context menu. Each tab opens a context menu that closes it on right click, long press, the Menu key and Shift+F10; with onCloseAll, the menu also offers Close all tabs, and the strip around the tabs opens it too.

props.name: closeAllLabel
props.description: Label of the Close all tabs item.

props.name: contextMenuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the context menu.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the strip, the tab list.

props.name: style
props.description: The strip's inline style.

props.name: ref
props.description: The strip, the tab list element.

Drawer.description: A panel that slides in from the start or end edge of the window over the page, for filters, details, an inspector or a phone's navigation: a modal by default, which traps focus and returns it on close, or beside the page with modal false. It takes the whole width of a narrow window, and a swipe toward its edge closes it. className, style, ref and data attributes go to the drawer's surface.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the drawer is open, for a drawer the application controls with onOpenChange.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether a drawer the application doesn't control is open on the first render.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the requested state, and why, when the drawer asks to open or close: from the trigger, Escape, an outside press, the close button, a swipe toward its edge or a DialogClose. Not called for a dismissal that pending blocks.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the drawer, such as a Button. It reports the drawer it opens, and focus returns to it on close. Omit it for a drawer the application opens with open.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge of the window the drawer slides in from: start, the left in left-to-right text, or end, the right. It follows the text direction, so it is mirrored in right-to-left text.

props.name: title
props.description: The drawer's heading and accessible name, such as Filters. Without one, name the drawer with aria-label, as a navigation drawer does.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The drawer's accessible name where it has no visible title.

props.name: description
props.description: Muted text under the title that describes the drawer to assistive technology too.

props.name: children
props.description: The content under the heading, such as filters, details or navigation. It scrolls.

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions at the end of the content, such as Apply, with the primary action last.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Whether the drawer shows its close button, a CloseButton at the end of the heading. Leave it out only where the drawer holds a control that closes it, such as a sidebar's own toggle.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The close button's name.

props.name: width
props.description: md, 24 rem, for details and filters; lg, 44 rem, for content-heavy panels such as tables and comparisons; or any CSS length, such as min(20rem, 100vw - 2rem). md and lg take the whole width of a window too narrow to leave the page beside them.

props.name: modal
props.description: true traps focus in the drawer over a backdrop, hides the page from assistive technology, blocks presses on it and locks its scroll. false leaves the page usable beside the drawer, for an inspector; it then closes when focus or a press goes outside it, unless disablePointerDismissal.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description: Keep the drawer open on presses outside it, and a non-modal drawer also when focus moves outside, such as an inspector beside the page it inspects. Escape and the close buttons still close it.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: The element to focus when the drawer opens, as a ref or a function of how it was opened. By default focus moves to the first element inside that takes Tab, such as the close button, or to the drawer itself when opened by touch or when nothing inside takes focus.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: The element to focus when the drawer closes, as a ref or a function of how it closed, such as the main content after a navigation. By default focus returns to the trigger, or to the element that had focus when it opened.

props.name: pending
props.description: Work started from the drawer is in progress: Escape, outside presses, swipes and the close button cannot dismiss it until pending returns to false, and the drawer reports busy.

DropZone.description: A drop target for files that also opens the file picker; the application shows what was chosen.

props.name: label
props.description: What to drop or choose, such as "Drop a logo here, or browse". With the description, it names the zone, as its visible text does.

props.name: description
props.description: Which files fit, such as "PNG, JPG or WebP up to 2 MB"; it is read as part of the name.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the upload icon.

props.name: accept
props.description: The file types the zone takes, as in the native accept attribute: MIME types such as image/png, groups such as image/*, and extensions such as .webp. Any file by default.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Take several files at once; otherwise the zone takes the first file.

props.name: onDropAccepted
props.description: Receives the dropped or chosen files that the zone takes.

props.name: onDropRejected
props.description: Receives the files that do not match accept, and those after the first without multiple.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The zone can't be pressed or focused and takes no files; it still keeps the browser from opening dropped files.

props.name: pending
props.description: The application is working on the files: a spinner replaces the icon, the zone reports that it is busy and takes no new files.

props.name: error
props.description: A message linked to the zone, whose outline takes the error color.

props.name: size
props.description: md is the tall area with a large icon; sm is one row with a small icon, for a form or a sidebar.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits files with a native form under this name: the last files the zone took, until the form resets, or files.

props.name: files
props.description: The files a named zone submits when the application keeps them, such as after a Remove action; they replace the files the zone took, also after the form resets.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of a form the zone belongs to when it is outside of it.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: The native file input that opens the file picker, for example from a Replace button.

EmptyState.description: What a region shows when it has nothing to show: no items yet, no matches, or content that failed to load. A title, a description, an optional icon and the action that resolves the state.

props.name: title
props.description: What is missing or what happened, such as "No projects yet"; a heading of `headingLevel`.

props.name: description
props.description: Why, and what people can do, in a sentence or two of muted text under the title.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative icon above the text; an error state shows the error icon without it.

props.name: action
props.description: The action that resolves the state, such as a Button that creates the first item.

props.name: children
props.description: More content under the description, such as a short list of next steps.

props.name: tone
props.description: neutral for a state with nothing to show yet; danger for content that failed to load, which shows the error icon by default and is announced as an alert. Pair it with a retry action.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The title's heading level in the page outline; 4 by default. The appearance stays the same.

props.name: align
props.description: `start` (default) for a state inside a card, panel or dialog. `center` for a state that takes the place of a page's or region's content: a larger icon, centred text and action, centred vertically in the height the application gives it.

EnvUIProvider.description: Sets the locale, the strings and the text direction of the envUI components inside it. envUI works without it, in English, in the runtime's locale and in each element's direction; an application that translates or formats for its people wraps itself, or a region, in one.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale envUI formats numbers, dates and relative times in, and reads plural rules, collation and the week's first day from, such as de-CH. Without it, the runtime's locale, from the browser once the page has hydrated.

props.name: messages
props.description: Overrides of envUI's built-in English strings, per namespace, such as `{ common: { close: 'Schließen' }, toast: { hidden: ({ count }) => t('hidden', { count }) } }`. A message is a string, or a function of the values it names. Nested providers merge per namespace, the inner winning; a component's own label prop, such as closeLabel, wins over both.

props.name: dir
props.description: The text direction for keyboard and placement logic, such as which arrow key moves forward and which side a popup's start is. Without it, each component reads the direction at its element, from dir attributes and CSS. It doesn't set the dir attribute: set that on the page or region.

Field.Control.description: The control: a native text input in the outlined field look by default, or any control through render, such as render={<MyControl />}, which receives the control's props, id and ref. A custom control styles itself; the class env-field-control gives it the field's outline.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component. Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the `value` changes. Use when controlled.

props.name: size
props.description: The height, as on every control: sm, md or lg in the current scale. Without it, the control height of the container.

Field.Description.description: Lasting guidance under the control, such as a format or a limit, linked to the control as its description.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component. Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

Field.Error.description: A message under the control that says how to correct the value, with an error icon. It shows while the field is invalid, from its own validation or from invalid on Field.Root, and is linked to the control; match="valueMissing" and the like show it for one kind of failure, and match={true} always.

props.name: style
